verdict.delta_sentence: Compared with the nearer intent-classification-2 reference, this board provides stronger tinted grouping and semantic flow colors but loses finish through several oversized dashed detours, ambiguous route convergence, and a less balanced use of the frame.

sub_checks.name: frame_use
sub_checks.note: The main process occupies most of the width, but the sparse central-lower band and large unused area beneath and beside the bottom groups weaken overall balance.

sub_checks.name: corridors_and_air
sub_checks.note: Nodes and most label chips have generous breathing room, though the long feedback routes consume corridors and crowd the boundary between Human handoff, governance, and Call artifacts.

sub_checks.name: grouping
sub_checks.note: Seven clearly titled, lightly tinted regions make intake, consent, routing, self-service, handoff, callback, governance, and artifacts easy to distinguish.

sub_checks.name: color
sub_checks.note: Distinct blue, amber, purple, teal, orange, green, magenta, and gray families are consistent with their regions, but the magenta dashed feedback line becomes visually dominant.

sub_checks.name: machinery_leakage
sub_checks.note: No crosshair junction glyphs appear, but arrowheads terminate into shared runs and the magenta and gray dashed routes converge near the lower center in a way that exposes routing machinery.

sub_checks.name: alignment_and_rhythm
sub_checks.note: The two-row primary flow and repeated card sizing establish rhythm, but the callback column, broad governance box, and artifacts box sit on inconsistent registers and create uneven density.

sub_checks.name: edge_legibility
sub_checks.note: Local edges are readable, but the gray caller-lookup route and magenta governance loop make large multi-region detours, run close together near the bottom center, and create ambiguous long-distance tracing.

verdict.rank_order_sanity_note: The assigned scores and visual ordering agree: gc-decomp-harness ranks first, intent-classification-2 second, and the board under grade third because its stronger grouping does not offset its conspicuous long-route clutter and weaker compositional finish.
